_comment: Landfall 2026-10-15: the land in the MIDDLE of the cast sequence (Plan::land_slot k >= 1). Seven
Forests and four OLD (non-sick) 0/1 Plant tokens, hand Avenger of Zendikar + Lava Spike + Mountain,
opponent at 7. Exact lethal T6 needs the Mountain BETWEEN the two casts: cast Avenger (the seven
Forests), play the Mountain (Avenger's landfall: a +1/+1 counter on every Plant, the four old ones
swing for 4), then Lava Spike off the Mountain (3). Land-first: Avenger enters after the land, no
counter, 3 damage. Land after ALL casts: no red for Lava Spike, 4 damage. So the T6 win is only the
mid-sequence position, applied lockstep by both worlds (the slot hooks in ApplyPlanDirect's
apply_plan_actions and AIEngine::TakeTurn's main cast loops).
